newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African stocks end firm in active trade.
newsitem.headline: S.African stocks end firm in active trade.

text.p: South African shares ended strong in active trade, with gold shares off their best levels but still firm on a brighter bullion price and industrials firm on positive sentiment.
Dealers said the market was surprisingly strong after expectations of a weak opening.
Follow-through buying from last week helped gains since most dealers were away on Monday ahead of the Heritage Day public holiday on Tuesday.
Gold shares were in demand in anticipation of a bullion price rally to $385-an-ounce by end of the week on the OTC options expiry on Thursday.
The overall index gained 41.9 points to 6,959.8 points, the industrial index added 33.1 points to 8,204 and the gold index was up 29.4 points to 1,751.
